services.desc: Legacy currently works with select charter schools as an approved vendor and accepts charter school enrichment funds. If your charter school is not yet on our approved list, we are open to new partnerships and happy to assist with the vendor approval process. Students of all ages get stronger, more flexible, and more active while having fun training alongside friends and family.
